card.name: Small words in non-English and place text
card.fires_on: Small linking words or word starts in the middle of a phrase, mostly in Malay or Spanish text and in place-name passages (islands, forts, peninsulas). Examples are 'itu', 'de', 'in', 'cual', 'Fort'.

modes.label: Malay and Spanish linking words
modes.description: Short connectors such as 'itu', 'de', 'cual' or the start of 'bahawa' inside Malay or Spanish sentences.

modes.label: Geographic names and lists
modes.description: Words inside or just before place names, such as 'Fort' before Morgan or 'Ne' in Necker, in island and coastline descriptions.
modes.example: from the western tip of<< Fort>> Morgan Peninsula eastward

modes.label: Opening bracket after a drug class
modes.description: An opening parenthesis after a drug class, before examples.

card.writes: It pushes toward word starts like 'cl', 'bal' and 'rum' and away from 'pe' pieces, which is a weak and mixed effect.
card.plain: It fires on small connecting words in Spanish or Malay text and on place names, where the next word is hard to guess.
